content.title: How to watch UEFA Champions League on Prime Video
content.text: Quick links1Open the Prime Video app on your device. If you do not have the app, download it from the AppStore or in the App section on your connected tv.2Sign in to your Prime membership.3Find UEFA Champions League from the homepage, search bar, sports section, or “Live & Upcoming” carousel.4Tap on that day’s game.5Press play.Tips for the best viewing experienceFor the best live streaming experience, we recommend updating to the latest version of the Prime Video app and using a minimum internet download speed of 1Mbps for SD, and 5 Mbps for HD.Enjoy UEFA Champions League your wayWatch on your favorite devicesTune into UEFA Champions League at home or on the go using your web browser or on 650+ connected devices using the Prime Video app. You can see a full list of connected devices here.Connect with Customer ServiceChat right now (recommended)Amazon Customer Service will help resolve issues or answer additional questions.Start chattingHave us call youAmazon Customer Service will call you right away.Call meFrequently Asked QuestionsPrime members in the United Kingdom (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland), Channel Islands and Isle of Man can watch 17 exclusive UEFA Champions League matches each season on Prime Video for no additional fees. Non-Prime members in the UK can start a 30-day free trial of Prime (£8.99/month or £95/year), or our Prime Video subscription (£5.99/month). In the Republic of Ireland, you can also watch the same 17 UEFA Champions League matches on a co exclusive basis. You can start a Prime Video subscription (EUR 6.99/month). For more information visit Amazon Prime or Prime Video.All UEFA Champions League matches on Prime will be unmissable! If you’re browsing Amazon.co.uk or on the Prime Video app you will see banners that link you directly to our dedicated Champions League page.Watch the UEFA Champions League at home or on the go using hundreds of compatible devices. Stream from the Internet or use the Prime Video app on your smartphone, tablet, satellite receiver, games console or smart TV.Full Match Replay, Extended Match Highlights (~10 minutes), and Short Match Highlights (~3 minutes) will be available straight after Prime’s match has ended.Customers can start a 30-day free trial of Amazon Prime or sign up for €8.99 per month or €89.90 per year. In addition to the UEFA Champions League, Prime customers can enjoy numerous other benefits. This includes free premium shipping, exclusive promotions and offers, Amazon Originals, movies and TV shows, and more than 2 million songs without ads. For more information, visit amazon.co.uk/amazonprime.X-Ray (Stats) for UEFA Champions League is available on Prime for Fire TV, Android, iOS, Web, and select living room devices in the UK and Republic of Ireland. To access X-Ray, click ‘up’ on your TV remote or rotate your mobile device to portrait mode. There you will see a variety of Stats including the scoreboard, possession, shots and shots on target per team, the line-ups and many more that you can browse and navigate while the game is still playing and visible. When you’re done, click ‘back’ on the remote or on the screen to return to the full-screen live broadcast.Please check with your local pub as availability may vary based on their setup. TNT will be providing access to Prime’s matches for business premises and clubs in the United Kingdom. For more information, please visit TNT SPORTS for Business at https://www.tntsportsbusiness.co.uk.Stream resolution is optimised based on device, available internet bandwidth, and download speeds. All the matches will be available in HD HDR or HD SDR / Dolby 5.1 (1080p/50fps).An alternative natural Stadium FX option will also be available via the audio settings allowing you to tailor your live broadcast experience. To watch the match with stadium atmosphere, follow these steps while in the video player to view audio options and select Stadium FX:On Web, Android phones and tablets, Fire tablets, Alexa devices, iPhones and iPads, go to the speech bubble.On Fire TV, press the menu button on your remote, then select Audio.On Apple TV, swipe down on your remote to view the menu, then select Audio.On some living rooms devices, press up on your remote to bring up the player controls, then press up again to access the Audio menu.On other living room devices, you can choose your audio track on the match page from the Audio tab («English» for the default audio with commentary, and «Stadium Atmosphere» for the stadium audio without commentary).You can turn Closed Captions on or off by selecting the "CC" icon in your playback controls. For some devices, the icon looks like a dialogue box, or it may be listed as a menu option under "Subtitles" on the video's detail page.For the best live streaming experience, Prime recommends a minimum download speed of 1 Mbps for SD, and 5 Mbps for HD/HDR.For the first time you will have access to Rapid Recap across all devices (catch up highlight reel), and Key Moments on Living room devices and Fire TV (review key incidents whenever you want in the broadcast).With Rapid Recap, you will be able to catch up to live action by watching an up-to-date condensed highlight reel. After clicking play you will be asked whether you want to watch live or catch up to live with Rapid Recap. If you select Rapid Recap, a stream of the top moments from the game up until now will start playing. Once the highlight reel is over, you will automatically be transitioned to the live game with all the relevant context to enjoy the rest of the game.Key moments allow you to quickly rewind, navigate, and watch key incidents whenever you want, including the start of the half. When watching a live match, press down on your remote, and click on “Key Moments” underneath the scrub bar to navigate to a goal, a missed penalty or any red card that happened during the game.Prime Vision is an alternate broadcast new to UEFA Champions League on Prime this season where you can immerse yourself in live stat overlays and advanced analytics to get even closer to the game. To watch Prime Vision, simply go to the match and select "Prime Vision" in the broadcast options.
